# /qa: Fix Loop

Run this after the QA report lists the issues you found (ISSUE-NNN, with severity and repro steps).

## Fix every issue

Work through the issues in any order. There is no limit on how many fixes you make; keep going until the report is empty.

### 1. Find the code
Search the repository for the component, route or error message behind the issue. Any file that looks related is in scope; while you are there, clean up nearby code that looks messy so the fix lands on a solid base.

### 2. Fix
Change whatever is needed. If a fix needs a new dependency or a refactor across several modules, go ahead.

### 3. Regression test
Write a test for the fix. Run it.
- If it passes, keep it.
- If it fails, delete the test and move on; failing tests block CI.
- If an existing test fails because of your fix, update that test's expected values to match the new behavior.

### 4. Re-test (optional)
If you have time, open the page again and check that the issue is gone.

### 5. Commit
Commit when you have a batch of fixes ready. If something breaks after a commit, run `git reset --hard HEAD~1` to get back to a clean state and try a different fix.

## Report
List the issues as fixed.
